title: Cron next fire time with the day-of-month / day-of-week OR rule
why_hard: Most of the spec matches common cron knowledge, but the day rule turns on whether a field's text starts with '*', not on whether it equals '*' or matches every day: '*/2' or '*/7' keep the AND rule. On top: weekday numbering (Sunday 0 and 7, while datetime.weekday() has Monday 0), '*/S' starting at the field minimum (day 1, month 1), strictly-later with seconds dropped, leap days including 2100, and a None answer that a minute-by-minute scan cannot reach quickly.
